summary: BMW Auto Leasing LLC filed an 8-K reporting entry into an Underwriting Agreement dated October 7, 2026 with BofA Securities as representative of underwriters for BMW Vehicle Lease Trust 2026-2's asset-backed notes: Class A-1 $223.0M, Class A-2a $305.6M, Class A-2b $175.0M, Class A-3 $480.6M, and Class A-4 $65.8M, totaling roughly $1.25B. Closing expected October 14, 2026, alongside a SUBI certificate issuance to BMW Manufacturing and transfer agreements. This is a routine auto-lease ABS shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch pricing and subscription levels rather than event-driven arbitrage.
